comments.author: @6Chihuahuas
comments.text: My first time visiting St. Thomas was back in 1993 during a cruise. The moment I climbed up to the lido deck and saw the beautiful breathtaking views of Charlotte Amalie, I fell in love with St. Thomas immediately. Through decades, I visited many islands in the Caribbean and the Bahamas, but none was able to capture my heart, like St. Thomas, my all-time favorite island.

replies.author: @BestTravel2
replies.text: It's wonderful that St. Thomas has remained such a special place in your heart after all these years!

comments.author: @BestGlobalTravelDocumentary
comments.text: Living in St. Thomas is expensive due to the "paradise tax" (11:49), as the island's remoteness requires importing most goods. To cope, residents rely on resourcefulness: shopping at local markets, growing backyard gardens for food , and using natural trade winds for cooling instead of costly air conditioning.
